decisions.text: a narrow-range inset: the values lie in a narrow range far from zero (499.6 to 504.9: the gap from zero is at least their spread) and the small differences among them matter (facts.small_differences_matter); the main scale keeps zero, and the inset shows every mark on a truncated scale, 499–506 by 1 (the largest step below the lowest value, so the lowest bar keeps a stub above the lowest gridline) (G2.7)
nominal categories in their given order
every name fits under its bar, neighbours at least 10 pt apart: vertical bars
the unit phrase on the top label: “600 g (mean fill weight per bag)”; the top gridline starts after it
highlighted in the strong shade of their colour: Line 4; the others keep their colour

one category axis for the two panels, the main chart's, at the foot of the stack; the inset does not repeat it: space is short, labelled twice the figure would be 470 pt high, over 331 pt (--inset-share-height × its width) (G2.27, D-56)
the inset above the main chart, spanning its width, at the same positions (s. 0081, s. 0297)

the inset's form: a frame round the band 400–600 of the main chart, across its width, a larger frame round a complete small chart (499–506 by 1, its unit restated on its top label (“506 g (mean fill weight per bag)”), no category or time labels of its own, the main chart's axis serving both, no title, text at inset size), two links forming a widening cone, beneath the frames (G2.27)
the inset's bars run 25.4 pt past its lowest gridline (499) and fade to transparent there: they do not start at zero, and nothing below the gridline pretends to be a length (G2.28)
500 g declared (500) as a dotted line in the dark grey across the plot, labelled at its end in bold (D-21 (c), G8.13, G7.16)
500 g declared drawn in the inset too, its value within the inset's range (499–506 by 1), named once, in the main chart (G6.2) (6.6, G8.13)
